name: INMOOD San Roque
about: A modern four-star resort in landscaped gardens between San Roque and Sotogrande, with over 130 rooms and suites, three restaurants and bars, a large outdoor pool with sun terrace and a fitness centre. The base for our Sotogrande Signature package: La Hacienda and San Roque Club are minutes away, and the hotel arranges club and trolley hire on request.
facilities: Club and trolley hire on request
Pet friendly, free Wi-Fi, private parking

name: Hotel Encinar de Sotogrande
about: A traditional Andalusian-style four-star hotel inside the Sotogrande estate, with over 100 rooms looking onto gardens or the golf, a Mediterranean restaurant, café, terrace bar, outdoor pool, tennis courts and a small gym. The hotel has a golf concierge and club and trolley rental, and Valderrama, La Cañada and The Alto are all a few minutes away. Our value pick for Sotogrande.
facilities: 100+ rooms with garden or golf views
Mediterranean restaurant, café and terrace bar
Golf concierge, club and trolley rental
Free Wi-Fi and parking, lockers with showers

name: SO/ Sotogrande
about: The five-star resort of Sotogrande, with designer interiors, over 150 rooms and suites, four restaurants and bars, a 3,500 square metre spa with hammam and sauna, an indoor heated pool, three outdoor pools and a gym. The Alto golf course is on site with buggies, trolleys, caddies and a concierge, and the hotel offers e-bikes, guided activities, valet and luxury transfers.
facilities: 3,500 m² spa with hammam and sauna
Indoor heated pool, three outdoor pools, gym
On-site golf: The Alto, buggies, caddies, concierge
E-bikes, guided activities, valet and luxury transfers

name: Drumoig Hotel & Golf Course
about: A countryside lodge-style hotel ten minutes from St Andrews with 29 en-suite rooms, its own 18-hole parkland course, a driving range and a restaurant and bar. Comfortable, friendly and well priced, which is why it anchors our St Andrews Signature package. No spa.

name: Fairmont St Andrews
location: St Andrews, clifftop over the North Sea
about: A five-star resort on the cliffs just south of St Andrews with 211 rooms and suites, two championship courses on the estate, the Torrance and the Kittocks, a full spa, indoor pool, gym and several restaurants. Kingsbarns, Crail and the East Neuk villages are a short drive along the coast.

name: Greyfriars Hotel
location: North Street, St Andrews town centre
about: A boutique hotel on North Street in the centre of St Andrews with more than 20 en-suite rooms and a popular restaurant and bar. A short walk from the Old Course, the Links Clubhouse and every pub in town, so the group can leave the cars where they are. No spa.
facilities: Walking distance to the Old Course

name: Druids Glen Hotel & Golf Resort
about: A five-star country estate resort forty minutes south of Dublin with 145 rooms and suites, Hugo's fine-dining restaurant, the all-day Garden Rooms, a bar and terrace, and a spa with Elemis treatments, thermal suite, indoor pool, jacuzzi, sauna, steam room and gym. Druids Glen and Druids Heath are on the estate, with Powerscourt, the Wicklow Mountains and Glendalough nearby.
facilities: Hugo's fine dining and The Garden Rooms
Spa with Elemis treatments, thermal suite and indoor pool

name: Woodstock House
about: A Georgian-style country house within the Druids Glen estate with nine guest rooms and suites, including two panoramic suites overlooking the Druids Glen and Druids Heath courses. Private dining for groups, and full access to the main resort's spa and restaurants. Ideal for a group of up to 18 who want the whole house.
facilities: 9 rooms and suites, two panoramic suites

name: Portmarnock Hotel & Golf Links
about: A four-star coastal resort on the Velvet Strand with 137 rooms and suites, The Bay Restaurant, the Cliff Lounge and Bar, Toast Café and a spa with Elemis treatments, indoor pool, gym, sauna and steam rooms. The Bernhard Langer links is on site and Dublin city centre is 15 minutes away.
facilities: The Bay Restaurant, Cliff Lounge & Bar, Toast Café
Spa with Elemis treatments and indoor pool
